name: Dreams Plum True
ingredients: Bombay Sapphire gin, plum, ginger, sage, lemon, egg white, plum bitters

recipe.item: plum syrup (or 1/2 oz plum purée + 1/4 oz simple syrup)
ginger syrup (or 1 barspoon fresh ginger juice)
plum bitters (Fee Brothers, or berry bitters)

method: If you need plum syrup, simmer 1/2 cup chopped ripe plum with 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water for about 8 minutes (add 3 slices of ginger for the last 3 minutes if you don't have ginger syrup), then strain and cool.
Dry-shake gin, lemon, plum syrup, ginger syrup, sage leaves, plum bitters, and egg white for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake 15 seconds more.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A sage leaf, and a thin plum slice if you have one

name: Sword Coast Special
ingredients: End of Days barrel-rested rum, Sandeman ruby port, Amaro Averna, orange, lime, cinnamon, vanilla, Angostura bitters, orange bitters
notes: Any good barrel-aged rum stands in for End of Days.

recipe.item: barrel-aged rum (End of Days, or any barrel-rested rum)

method: Make a quick cinnamon-vanilla syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water, and 2 cinnamon sticks for 5 minutes; stir in 1/2 tsp vanilla off the heat, then cool and strain.
Shake rum, ruby port, Averna, orange, lime, syrup, and both bitters with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain over one big cube in a rocks glass.
garnish: Orange twist and a cinnamon stick

name: Whiskey Powers
ingredients: Maker's Mark bourbon, jalapeño agave, lime, cinnamon, vanilla, egg white
notes: Made at home. Elijah Craig works too.
method: Make the jalapeño-cinnamon-vanilla agave syrup (see the Calculator tab): simmer 1/2 cup agave, 1/2 cup water, 1 sliced jalapeño, and 2 cinnamon sticks; stir in 1/2 tsp vanilla off the heat, then cool and strain. About 8 oz per batch.
Dry-shake bourbon, lime, syrup, and egg white for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake 15 seconds more.
Strain over one big cube in a rocks glass.
garnish: Lime wheel, jalapeño slice, or a dusting of cinnamon

name: Pomfoolery
ingredients: Lunazul tequila, Domaine de Canton, pomegranate, champagne, lemon, smoked rosemary
notes: To smoke the rosemary, torch a sprig until it smolders and rest it on the glass.
method: Shake tequila, Domaine de Canton, pomegranate juice, and lemon with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Top with champagne.
Torch a rosemary sprig until it smokes and rest it on the glass.
garnish: Smoked rosemary sprig

name: Envy
ingredients: Tito's vodka, Malibu coconut rum, amaretto, lemon, pandan
method: Make pandan syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water with 8 pandan leaves for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. If you can't find leaves, stir 1/8 tsp pandan extract into 1/2 cup cooled simple syrup.
Shake vodka, Malibu, amaretto, lemon, and pandan syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a highball over fresh ice.
garnish: Lemon wheel or a short pandan leaf

name: Jalapeño Margarita
ingredients: Lunazul blanco tequila, jalapeño agave, lime, Tajín rim
notes: Uses the same jalapeño-cinnamon-vanilla agave syrup as the Whiskey Powers.
method: Use the same jalapeño-cinnamon-vanilla agave syrup as the Whiskey Powers (see the Calculator tab).
Rim a rocks glass with lime and Tajín.
Shake tequila, lime, and syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain over fresh ice in the rimmed rocks glass.
garnish: Tajín rim, plus a lime wheel or jalapeño slice

name: Strawberry Stick & Poke
ingredients: Stoli vanilla vodka, Frangelico, Kahlúa, strawberry, hand-whipped cream

recipe.item: ripe strawberries, muddled (or 3/4 oz strawberry purée)
simple syrup (skip if using sweetened purée)
heavy cream, hand-whipped to a soft float

method: Muddle the strawberries with the simple syrup in a shaker (or start with strawberry purée and skip the extra syrup if it's already sweet).
Add vodka, Frangelico, and Kahlúa; shake with ice for 15 seconds.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
Softly whip the cold cream to a pourable ribbon and float it on top.
garnish: A strawberry half, or a light dusting of cocoa

name: Ambrosia
ingredients: Stoli vanilla vodka, ChocoLat, crème de cacao, Kahlúa, heavy cream, chocolate bitters
notes: ChocoLat is a chocolate liqueur; Godiva, Mozart, or another chocolate liqueur works.
method: Shake vodka, ChocoLat, crème de cacao, Kahlúa, cream, and chocolate bitters with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: Shaved chocolate, or a few extra drops of chocolate bitters on the cream

name: Campfire Coffee
ingredients: Stoli vanilla vodka, crème de cacao, Baileys, hot coffee, toasted marshmallow
method: Add vodka, crème de cacao, and Baileys to a pre-warmed mug.
Top with hot coffee and stir.
Toast a marshmallow over a flame until browned and perch it on the rim, or float it on the drink.
garnish: Toasted marshmallow

name: Peppermint Bark Martini
ingredients: Stoli vanilla vodka, Rumple Minze peppermint liqueur, Mozart chocolate liqueur, crème de cacao, heavy cream
notes: Rumple Minze is intense; keep it at 1/2 oz so the chocolate can keep up.
method: Shake vodka, Rumple Minze, Mozart chocolate liqueur, crème de cacao, and cream with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
garnish: Shaved chocolate or a pinch of crushed peppermint

name: Espresso Martini
ingredients: Vodka, coffee liqueur (usually Kahlúa), espresso or cold brew concentrate, simple syrup

recipe.item: freshly brewed espresso (or cold brew concentrate)

method: Shake vodka, coffee liqueur, espresso, and simple syrup hard with ice for 15 seconds, until well chilled and foamy.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe or martini glass.
garnish: 3 coffee beans

name: Paper Plane
ingredients: Bourbon, Aperol, Amaro Nonino Quintessentia, fresh lemon juice
notes: The name wasn't on the screenshot; this equal-parts spec is the Paper Plane.
method: Shake bourbon, Aperol, Amaro Nonino, and lemon with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: None, or a thin lemon twist

name: Naked and Famous
ingredients: Mezcal (preferably Del Maguey Chichicapa), Aperol, yellow Chartreuse, fresh lime juice
method: Shake mezcal, Aperol, yellow Chartreuse, and lime with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: None, or a lime twist

name: Bourbon Pumpkin Smash
ingredients: Spiced pumpkin syrup, bourbon or whiskey, orange or clementine juice, orange bitters, ginger beer (optional)
notes: Batch for 4: 1 1/2 cups bourbon, 1/2 cup orange juice, 6–8 dashes orange bitters, and 4 ginger beers, plus the full syrup recipe below (use 1–2 oz syrup per drink to taste).
method: Make the spiced pumpkin syrup: simmer 1/2 cup maple syrup, 1/3 cup water, 1/3 cup pumpkin purée, 1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice, 1 tsp vanilla, and a pinch of sea salt for about 5 minutes, then cool.
Shake bourbon, 1 1/2 oz syrup (use 1–2 oz to taste), orange juice, and bitters with ice for 15 seconds.
Pour over ice in a rocks glass and top with ginger beer if you like.
garnish: An orange slice, or a dusting of pumpkin pie spice

name: Pay the Piper
ingredients: Rye, St. Germain, pear, rosemary, ginger, lemon, hard cider
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.

recipe.item: rosemary sprig, for the shake and garnish

method: If you need ginger syrup, simmer 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water, and 1/4 cup sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain.
Shake rye, St. Germain, pear, lemon, ginger syrup, and a rosemary sprig with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a highball over fresh ice and top with hard cider.
Garnish with a fresh rosemary sprig.
garnish: Rosemary sprig

name: Almost Famous
ingredients: Mezcal, Aperol, passionfruit, honey, lime
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: If you need honey syrup, stir equal parts honey and hot water until smooth, then cool.
Shake mezcal, Aperol, passionfruit, lime, and honey syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A lime wheel, or a little passionfruit pulp

name: Accidentally in Love
ingredients: Gin, green Chartreuse, lemon, honey, pistachio
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Make a quick pistachio syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water, and 1/4 cup chopped pistachios for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Orgeat is a decent stand-in.
Shake gin, green Chartreuse, lemon, honey syrup, and pistachio syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: Crushed pistachios on the foam, or a lemon twist

name: Off the Beeten Path
ingredients: Gin, Cynar, Domaine de Canton, Ancho Reyes, beet, honey, lemon
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Shake gin, Cynar, Domaine de Canton, Ancho Reyes, beet, honey syrup, and lemon with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A lemon twist

name: Raising Canes
ingredients: Rum, cinnamon-apple infused vermouth, Averna, grapefruit, lemon, Angostura
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. If you don't have cinnamon-apple infused vermouth, use 3/4 oz sweet vermouth plus 1/4 oz apple cider and a pinch of cinnamon, or a barspoon of cinnamon syrup.
method: If you need a stand-in for the infused vermouth, stir 3/4 oz sweet vermouth with 1/4 oz apple cider and a pinch of cinnamon (or a barspoon of cinnamon syrup).
Shake rum, vermouth, Averna, grapefruit, lemon, and Angostura with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A grapefruit twist

name: Get Off My Lawn
ingredients: Tequila, orange liqueur, ancho pepper, cumin, lime, Tajín
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Rim a rocks glass with lime, then Tajín mixed with a pinch of cumin.
Shake tequila, orange liqueur, Ancho Reyes, lime, and a pinch of cumin with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain over fresh ice in the rimmed rocks glass.
garnish: Tajín-cumin rim and a lime wheel

name: Smoked Old Fashioned
ingredients: Bourbon, sorghum molasses, Angostura, orange, cherry-wood smoke
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. If you don't have sorghum molasses, use a barspoon of maple syrup or rich demerara syrup.
method: Stir bourbon, sorghum molasses, and Angostura with ice until well chilled.
Strain over one big cube in a rocks glass.
Express an orange peel over the drink and drop it in.
Smoke the glass or the finished drink with cherry wood — a smoking gun, or invert the glass over a lit cherry-wood chip for a few seconds, then pour.
garnish: Expressed orange peel and cherry-wood smoke

name: Aperol Spritz
ingredients: Aperol, prosecco, orange slice
notes: Home recipe. The classic build also uses a splash of soda; skip it if you want it richer.
method: Fill a highball or wine glass with ice.
Add prosecco, then Aperol, then a splash of soda, and give it a gentle stir.
garnish: An orange slice

name: Mojito
ingredients: Muddled lime, fresh mint, simple syrup, white rum, seltzer

recipe.item: fresh lime juice (or 1/2 lime, cut into wedges)

method: Gently muddle the mint with the syrup and lime in a shaker (don't shred the leaves).
Add the rum and ice, and shake for 10 seconds.
Pour into a highball over fresh ice and top with seltzer.
Give it a light stir.
garnish: A mint sprig and a lime wheel

name: Feeling Peachy
ingredients: Basil Hayden bourbon, peach schnapps, bitters, muddled cherry and orange
method: Muddle the orange slice and cherries in a shaker.
Add bourbon, peach schnapps, and bitters; shake with ice for 10 seconds.
Pour over ice in a rocks glass.
garnish: A cherry and an orange slice
